title: SAIC connection to Crane
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: our friend UAP gerb has dug up a lot of research around saic's work with Crane

plain: SAIC, a large American defense contractor, is said to have done work connected to Crane, a US Navy research base in Indiana. Michels raises this himself in an episode with a guest who says he saw alien technology at a military base, and credits the digging to an online researcher who goes by "UAP Gerb" (UAP being the government's term for UFOs). He says this researcher has turned up "a lot of research" on the link, which would tie a private contractor to the base at the centre of the guest's story.
